# dllhost.exe is all Rust (dllhost-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dllhost-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dllhost.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dllhost-rust/src/dllhost/dllhost.rs)
add_cargo_module(dllhost dllhost-cargo dllhost.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE dllhost-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
